findings.problem: Repeated top25 keyword made original evaluator syntactically invalid; boolean/list name collision also affected recall aggregation.
findings.resolution: Separate top25_hit from output list top25; update summary; validate actual submitted list with official first_correct_rank and reciprocal_rank.

findings.problem: Original evaluator did not explicitly anchor immutable freeze/model/scorer hashes, config/source receipt file hashes, or fixed785 count.
findings.resolution: Pin declared model/scorer/freeze hashes and count; bind archived scorer/configuration/pre-inference source receipts; check complete common candidate rows before truth.

findings.problem: Traversal with null predictions may exit0 with completed_candidate_traversal_with_missing_predictions; exit0 does not prove complete inference.
findings.resolution: Evaluator refuses any incomplete status or missing/nonfinite score before opening truth; no zero imputation or query removal.

missing_prediction_policy: refuse entire evaluation before truth; no metric or zero imputation
ranking_policy: descending score, ascending original candidate_index ties; construct list with first valid official identity occurrence; cap25; verify rank/RR of actual output using official helper
native_spectral_rule: forward fragment channels, raw>.001, both precursor channels removed, common observed precursor removal max(.01Da,100ppm), native adjacent-bin chaining .01Da, sqrt cosine
